Done. Summary of what I did:

1. **Diagnosed**: checkout-api was unhealthy on v2.3.1 in all three production regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west) with an ~18% error rate.

3. **Verified**: checkout-api is now healthy across all regions with a ~0.2% error rate.
4. **Filed incident**: Opened SEV2 incident **INC-0001** paging on-call, describing the v2.3.1 failure, the rollback to v2.3.0 (including the partial rollout/retry), and follow-up needed to diagnose v2.3.1 and the orchestrator issue.

Note: the incident creation call initially returned a timeout, but I confirmed the incident was created successfully, so on-call was only paged once.
